notes: Limitation (findings log): the bucket rule language sees the object document (path, owner_id, ...) but cannot derive the household from the path prefix, and an object carries no household_id field to index the claim by. Until rules can read a path segment (or objects carry application fields), access is owner-only: the uploader is the only member who can read or delete the receipt, so a household member who did not upload it cannot open it.
Task 2.6 revisits this with the household claim once the platform supports it.
